synopsis: The corpus cites two strands of CVPR 2024 on-road research: RadSimReal on radar simulation-to-real transfer and Li et al. on misleading open-loop evaluation [f327, f5244]. RadSimReal provides evidence that physical radar simulation can narrow detection-training gaps, but the reported results are limited to urban datasets and a measurable domain gap remains, especially in adverse weather [f3933, f472, f327]. Li et al. showed that open-loop planning metrics on nuScenes could be matched using the vehicle's own state alone, creating a misleading impression and potentially biased benchmark conclusions [f5518, f5184]. Chapter 7 consequently flags open-loop replay of raw logs as subject to open-loop bias; the supplied evidence is on-road rather than direct validation for heavy off-road machines [f5679, f3933, f5184].
